transport_rtt.label: transport_rtt
transport_rtt.caveat: PRIMARY transport metric: both stamps from the teacher's own monotonic clock.

teacher_to_server_ack.label: teacher_to_server_ack
teacher_to_server_ack.caveat: Round trip to the relay only - isolates the teacher->server hop.

one_way.label: one_way_shared_host_clock
one_way.caveat: Built-in teacher and student endpoints share one host clock, so this is the measured teacher-send -> simulated-student-receive duration through the relay. It does not include a real Student UI or hardware.

notes: Transport RTT is the primary metric; it needs no clock synchronisation.
